description: 6 deterministic offline trap benchmark cases testing compound splitting, causal overclaim, qualifier drop, secondary citation misattribution, pubinfo hallucination, and dedup+conflict graph.

cases.description: Single assertion packs multiple metrics/clauses with 'respectively' or semicolon.

anchors.text: Model A achieves 88.2% accuracy on MMLU and 74.5% on GSM8K, reducing latency by 30% respectively.

candidate_nanopubs.subject: Model A
candidate_nanopubs.statement: Model A achieves 88.2% accuracy on MMLU and 74.5% on GSM8K, reducing latency by 30% respectively.
candidate_nanopubs.evidence_quote: Model A achieves 88.2% accuracy on MMLU and 74.5% on GSM8K, reducing latency by 30% respectively.

cases.description: Evidence says 'correlated with / suggests' while claim upgrades to 'causes'.

anchors.text: Sleep duration is negatively correlated with systolic blood pressure (r = -0.34, p < 0.05), which suggests a potential link.

candidate_nanopubs.subject: Short sleep duration
candidate_nanopubs.statement: Short sleep duration causes elevated systolic blood pressure (r = -0.34, p < 0.05).
candidate_nanopubs.evidence_quote: Sleep duration is negatively correlated with systolic blood pressure (r = -0.34, p < 0.05), which suggests a potential link.

cases.description: Evidence contains dosage, temperature, pH, sample size, and in vitro conditions omitted by claim.

anchors.text: At 37°C and pH 7.4 in vitro, 10 mg/kg Compound X inhibited enzyme Y activity (n = 30, p < 0.01).

candidate_nanopubs.subject: Compound X
candidate_nanopubs.statement: Compound X inhibits enzyme Y activity.
candidate_nanopubs.evidence_quote: At 37°C and pH 7.4 in vitro, 10 mg/kg Compound X inhibited enzyme Y activity (n = 30, p < 0.01).

cases.description: Intro sentence citing prior work [12] is mislabeled as primary_study_finding.

anchors.text: Previous work by Smith et al. [12] showed that unmitigated gradient clipping slows convergence on sparse graphs.

candidate_nanopubs.subject: Unmitigated gradient clipping
candidate_nanopubs.statement: Unmitigated gradient clipping slows convergence on sparse graphs.
candidate_nanopubs.evidence_quote: Previous work by Smith et al. [12] showed that unmitigated gradient clipping slows convergence on sparse graphs.

cases.description: PubInfo claims a fabricated DOI absent from document text.

candidate_nanopubs.subject: Minimal Preprint
